name: Phantasy Star II Text Adventure: Rudger no Bouken
original_name: ファンタシースターII テキストアドベンチャー ルドガーの冒険
source:
Phantasy Star II Text Adventures were a series of eight text adventure videogames available to users of Sega Meganet, a modem for the Sega Mega Drive in Japan, and later released as part of two compilations on the Sega Mega-CD. Each of the games takes place shortly before Phantasy Star II, documenting the backgrounds of its characters, and explaining what brings them to the town Paseo where they eventually team up to investigate the pervasive troubles of the Algol Solar System.

Rudger's Adventure

This chapter features Rudolf "Rudo" Steiner (Japanese: ルドガー・スタイナー (Rudogā Steiner or Rudger Steiner)), who after the loss of his wife and child in a Biomonster attack, becomes a hunter dedicated to their extermination.

[From: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantasy_Star_II_Text_Adventures]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《梦幻之星II文字冒险》是由八部文字冒险游戏组成的系列作品，最初面向日本世嘉Mega Drive主机网络外设“Sega Meganet”的订阅用户推出，后收录于两张合集光盘登陆世嘉Mega-CD平台。每部作品的故事皆发生在《梦幻之星II》正篇开幕前夕，旨在描绘各位同伴角色的身世过往，交代他们因何机缘汇聚至帕塞奥镇，并最终结伴调查蔓延整个阿尔戈尔星系的重重异变。

《鲁德格的冒险》

本篇主角是鲁道夫·“鲁多”·斯坦纳（日版原名：鲁德格·斯坦纳）。在挚爱的妻儿惨死于生物怪兽袭击后，悲愤交加的他毅然化身为赏金猎人，立誓将世间所有生物怪兽赶尽杀绝。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantasy_Star_II_Text_Adventures]Wikipedia[/url]]
